verdict.rationale: Pipedream Connect explicitly supports embedding auth/tool-calling into your own product with external_user_id-scoped accounts, SDKs (TS/Python/Java), REST API, and usage/billing APIs for end-user tracking, which is the core of white-labeling. However, there is no explicit evidence of white-label UI theming/branding controls (custom domain, logo/color removal of Pipedream branding) in the pack. missing for 10: documented white-label branding/theming options, custom domain support, independent case study of a product embedding Pipedream white-label.
